stem_book: Three objects A, B and C are kept in a straight line on a frictionless horizontal surface. These have masses m, 2m and m respectively. The object A moves towards B with a speed 9 m/s and makes an elastic collision with it. Thereafter, B makes a completely inelastic collision with C. All motions occur on the same straight line. Find the final speed of the object C. (a) 3 m/s (b) 4 m/s (c) 5 m/s (d) 1 m/s
reason: print's figure labels C as 2m, contradicting the text (m, 2m, m); original IIT-JEE 2009 P2 integer Q has masses m, 2m, m, answer 4 (with C = 2m it would be 3 m/s, option a). Stem fixed to m, 2m, m; figure deliberately omitted since it only repeats the masses and carries the misprint. Print tags it JEE Adv 2010 P1 but it is IIT-JEE 2009 P2.
work: elastic A→B: v_B = 2m_A u/(m_A + m_B) = 2·9/3 = 6 m/s; B+C stick: v = 2m·6/(3m) = 4 m/s
